question: Ritik is ranked 6th from top in his class, while Akshay is 18th from bottom. If their position is interchanged, Akshay gets 15th from bottom. What is the number of students in the class?
solution:
Given,

 
• Ritik is 6th from top and Akshay 18th is from bottom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e63600078ce261267cac0f802f828806b423a9e263a2c47a60dc00524fae6e24.png] 

 
• When Ritik and Akshay interchange their position,Ritik becomes 18th from bottom and Akshay becomes 6th from top and 15th from bottom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a7ad63115761cf1f5d6b8e1301007410c62737ddfd29000a8ce733611795f43.png] 

**Total number of students = Position from bottom + Position from top - 1**

= 15 + 6 - 1

= 21 - 1 

= 20 Students

Hence, the correct answer is **"20".**
